title: Fix: report empty state-machine and accessibility test inventories as NOT_RUN, never PASS; keep all runnable suites and gates enforced

why5.question: Why does Sprint3 closure candidate #396 fail the Draft full fallback?
why5.answer: build-spec/CURRENT.json selects FULL_FALLBACK; test:state-machine and test:a11y both returned exit 1 for zero existing matching test files in their configured directories.

why5.question: Why is bypassing the whole Fast-loop unacceptable?
why5.answer: The other nine real test families must execute normally, and missing scripts, unknown families or missing suite directories must still fail closed.

why5.question: Why not add fake test cases to make the harness green?
why5.answer: A dummy test would falsely claim acceptance and obscure missing state-machine and a11y coverage. Their real coverage remains NOT_RUN_NO_TEST_FILES.

why5.question: Why keep this change separate from the five-file closure transition?
why5.answer: The constitution permits the exact administrative closure transition to modify only those five fixed paths, and separately requires governance selector changes to be Human-approved.

why5.question: Why is this change not a product acceptance waiver?
why5.answer: It only classifies a genuinely empty test inventory as NOT_RUN and still runs all populated suites; no individual test or GCCA gate is treated as PASS without actually executing.

alternatives: Force npm test commands with empty suite dirs to PASS: prohibited fake green.
Exclude state-machine and a11y from configuration silently: hides coverage obligation.
Add dummy placeholder tests: false evidence and product scope creep.
Change protected workflows or package scripts: increases risk and changes unapproved bytes.
Selected minimal path: classify empty suites NOT_RUN with real inventory evidence and fail closed for other anomalies.
no_change: Sprint3 #396 remains DRAFT because the full fallback tests always return exit 1 for two README-only directories, despite other test categories passing.
rollback: Separate Human-approved revert of only harness/scripts/select-impacted-tests.mjs. Preserve this governance exception decision docket as historical, append-only; never rewrite existing Product truth.
negative_tests: Selector synthetic tests: missing npm script is a HARD FAIL; changed npm command is a HARD FAIL; unknown suite is rejected; regex examples distinguish actual .test.ts/.spec.ts from README.md.
Selector actual GitHub Fast-loop at candidate source 0cffea836659dd787c85f26c156d7cb72af03208: 9 suites with files, two truly empty suites emitted NOT_RUN_NO_TEST_FILES and NEVER PASS.
Candidate GitHub Fast-loop GATE_ONLY: check:lint PASS; synthetic selector test PASS; formal Draft GCCA are intentionally NOT_READY, not executed full.

Full fallback on Sprint3 closure #396 prior to fix: 12 test categories PASS and test:state-machine + test:a11y each FAIL because no test files were found. After this governance-only fix, rerun exact full fallback, do not infer PASS.

scope_exception.reason: Human 2026-10-15 direct request to fix identified root cause: two README-only test directories must not cause false-fast-loop FAIL. New independent proposal, not reopening rejected PR #397.
scope_exception.risk: Misclassification could hide tests if scripts or directory layout changes; stricter command equality, known-suite mapping, missing directory hard failure, visible NOT_RUN and separate Human exact approval guard this risk.
scope_exception.owner: Human (NFF98) approval, GPT planning and independent evidence BCE, GitHub canonical CI
scope_exception.follow_up: After separate exact Human authorization, required real verification and BCE, separate final-ready and Merge permission for this tooling correction, independently verify PR #398 closure and complete administrative HOLD. Never start Sprint4.
scope_exception.expires_at_rule: UNAPPROVED: after a new exact-byte Human candidate approval, set expiry at most 14 days after its dated decision.

carry_forward.justification: This narrowly scoped selector correction creates, defers and waives no Product Acceptance, Sprint task or Backlog obligation. Empty suites remain explicit NOT_RUN, and the nine Sprint3 GAP rows are in the separate closure draft #396.

known_limitations: Direct Human request to fix root cause permits preparation, not final exact-byte Merge.
Prior rejected and CLOSED/unmerged PR #397 is NOT revived, reopened, or treated as authorized; only independently reviewed code behavior is reused.
Any 0-file test family is NOT_RUN_NO_TEST_FILES and must never count as executed Product PASS.
All 4 GCCA, Final Ready and independent Human Merge gate remain mandatory, and PR #398 Sprint3 closure is not yet merged.
